stop_hold_conditions: New pain, illness concern, functional limitation or clearance dependency: stop dependent prescriptive judgment and clinical route. Unexpected nonclinical effort or coordination loss: pause/recheck; bounded accepted remainder may be curtailed; never force completion.

No substitute dose as a response to clinical concern

recovery_burden_expectation.qualitative: Re-exposure unknown after interruption; confidence lower than ongoing familiar training
recovery_burden_expectation.uncertainty: Contextual estimate only; no fixed recovery clock, fatigue score, causal attribution or double counting with actual exposure

uncertainty_handling.confidence: MODERATE only for comparable synthetic familiar case; LOW for novelty/return; no confidence score
uncertainty_handling.unknown_action: ASK when answer changes decision; otherwise retain explicit uncertainty and eligible bounded action
uncertainty_handling.evidence_gap: Exact novice/return dose and full trajectory are design candidates; no direct sufficient prescriptive evidence claimed
